passages.context: Paragraphs 2-3 were read with the complete address. They distinguish bodily healing from salvation, join saving faith to gratitude and openness to grace, and interpret spiritual leprosy as sin healed by conversion.
passages.notes: The HTML does not print paragraph numbers. The locator counts the salutation as paragraph 1 and excludes the post-Angelus appeal. No comparison with the Italian version is claimed.
